text:
I’d score this **6.5/10**. The code is readable, small, typed, and has decent behavior-focused tests. I would not call it a mess.

I would still **not approve it as-is** for production-facing client-library work. The main blocker is unsafe path construction for resource IDs, plus retry/response-handling gaps that will produce surprising behavior under real API/network conditions. Tests pass once dependencies are installed: `32 passed`. Editable install failed in this environment because `/work` is read-only, so I tested with dependencies installed separately.

Estimated rewrite/significant-change size: **130 lines**, mostly client retry/path/response handling plus tests.

issues.description: Project IDs are interpolated into URL paths without path-segment escaping, so '/', '..', or '?' alter the request route/query.
Batch-create project IDs are interpolated into URL paths without escaping, allowing malformed or unintended endpoint requests.
Task IDs are interpolated into annotation-list paths without escaping, causing path traversal/query injection bugs for valid-looking IDs.
Annotation IDs are interpolated into review paths without escaping, allowing route confusion for IDs containing reserved URL characters.
Retry-After parsing supports only numeric seconds and ignores valid HTTP-date Retry-After headers.
Retry-After delays are not capped, so a server or proxy can make the client sleep for an arbitrarily long time.
Transient httpx transport errors are not retried and leak as raw httpx exceptions instead of client-level errors.
Pagination silently accepts malformed success bodies, including missing items, instead of raising a typed protocol error.
Batch-create trusts server-supplied result indexes without validating one result per input task, so dropped or duplicate results pass silently.
Review success parsing trusts arbitrary response shapes and can raise KeyError/ValueError rather than a stable client exception.
Retry configuration validates max_attempts only; negative backoff_base/backoff_cap can produce invalid sleep behavior.
BatchItemResult accepts any status string despite declaring a Literal, so invalid API states are not caught at parse time.
__version__ duplicates pyproject.toml version and can drift from the package metadata.
Package metadata is incomplete for distribution: no license, authors, classifiers, project URLs, or typed-package marker configuration.
Dev tooling declares pytest only; there is no configured formatter, linter, type checker, or coverage gate for active development.
